 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. We're back for one last Sunday of breakfast football. The Patriots and Lions are live in Munich this morning. The Lions sit a half game back of the Vikings for the top of the NFC North.
 Speaking of the Vikings, they travel to Lambeau to face the Packers in the 10 a.m. window. Kirk Cousins makes his Vikings debut after that huge deadline deal. That's the most interesting early game with Chiefs-Falcons also kinda interesting. The Chiefs have been a bit hit or miss of late, while the Falcons could maybe surprise them in Atlanta.
 We'll be back at 1:25 for 49ers-Cowboys, with the rest of the NFC West also playing in that window. Until then, enjoy some morning football!
